snippet.title: Up-Beat!! - Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
ITCH.IO: https://waterfowlgames.itch.io/up-beat
STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4654390/UpBeat_Demo/
NEWGROUNDS: https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/project/7572275

The Up-Beat!! Demo is now available. Try it now at the links above!

DISCORD LINK: https://discord.gg/xWw2GPgt5q

Up-Beat!! is a cartoony, over the top boxing game heavily inspired by games such as Punch-Out!!, Friday Night Funkin', and Rhythm Heaven.  Play as Ray, a young woman on a mission to conquer the introductory circuit and prove her worth to her trainer. With Katja by your side to give you advice in-between rounds, nothing can stand in your way.

This demo features...

-4 Action-packed fights!

-Easily accessible mod tools to play custom fights, or make your own!

-An unforgettable soundtrack by SO87!

-jiggle physics

And a wide range of voice acting from Vtubers such as Peni Qubit & Lemi Lichen...  Up-Beat!! will undoubtedly deliver as the spiritual successor you've been looking for this entire time.

This trailer was voiced by Juza Voices. You can find more of his work here:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCQbpMU2YLOTFiEjMN2bZ0tw
https://www.twitch.tv/juzavoices

#upbeat #upbeatgame #boxing
